reviews.review:
its another left 4 dead clone, but probably the worst ive played so far.
the combat is probably the worst, its boring.
most enemies die with 1-3 blasts from a shotgun and do barely any damage so you can just waltz right through them.
besides some ambient music there is no music. it just feels boring and slow.

This game is a decent Left4Dead clone and can provide some fun if you have friends to play through the campaign with. Even then, keep in mind that you can beat all the campaign episodes in about 5 hours, so don't expect to get a lot of playtime out of it. Also, the game has basically no plot and the characters are very shallow, so don't expect much there. That's pretty standard for L4D clones, but the world in this one is even more threadbare than most. Others like Vermintide and Back 4 Blood at least made some effort at world building. 

However, just keep in mind that the multiplayer is dead, so don't expect get play with random people or get a 4v4 match going. You can look this game up on Steam Charts and see that the monthly average players is 3.4 per day and even on a Saturday night it only peaks at 7, so not enough to fill one versus match.

L4D clone in space not much more. It was nice when playing in co-op and even random players joined in. Very short game and got thru it in just 6 hours. It has one good innovation that when you go afk in co-op session AI takes control of the character and you can just take control again when you get back. All in all cannot leave positive review with the game in this state.

this game is god awful, couldnt even get it to run multiplayer 9 times out of 10. Even when it did work its was the most boring experience i've ever had the displeasure of experiencing. Devs dont even care for their community. 0/10 would rather play with literal burning trash
